meta.title: Villa Solia Blagaj – villa with pool near the Buna spring | DEMO
meta.description: Villa Solia in Blagaj near Mostar: a peaceful villa for families and groups, close to the Buna spring and the Dervish house. Check availability and send a booking inquiry.

demo.banner: DEMO version – test data. Inquiries are not sent to the owner and are not real bookings.

hero.title: Peace, sunshine and Herzegovinian stone
hero.lead: A spacious villa for families and friends, minutes from the Buna spring and the Dervish house in Blagaj.

about.title: Welcome to Villa Solia
about.p1: Villa Solia is a place for unhurried holidays: morning coffee on the terrace, afternoons by the pool and evenings under the Herzegovinian stars.
about.p2: From the villa you can easily reach the Buna spring, the Old Bridge in Mostar, Kravice waterfalls and Počitelj.
about.note: Text and facts are sample content for this demo and should be replaced with the owner's real details.
